It would show which ones were actually tested running TrueNAS and Unraid: BIOS access, boot drive options, whether QuickSync and the network ports work, and each maker's warranty stance. why: No major reviewer or authority answers this. The results are affiliate roundups and niche homelab blogs that name the DXP4800 Plus, the LincStation S1 or TerraMaster from specs, without checkable testing on third-party OSes. Several pages answer neighbouring questions (DIY builds, used servers, cases, TrueNAS vs Unraid). The NASCompares page compares the operating systems, not prebuilt hardware.
